evidence.note: CoRAP is a conformal-prediction framework that constructs statistically valid uncertainty sets over reasoning-answer pairs for large reasoning models (guaranteeing a correct answer supported by valid reasoning is covered with a user-specified probability), paired with a Shapley-value-based example-to-step explanation method that provably identifies which training examples and reasoning steps are sufficient to achieve that coverage.
evidence.title: Quantifying and Understanding Uncertainty in Large Reasoning Models
